force_or_pressure: Time scarcity, relief, status, travel, attention and escape
control_point: Repeatable capture of time, place, habit and convenience
burden_carrier: Labor, leases, food/input costs, franchisees and integration
operating_denominator: Same-unit demand, labor hours, occupancy/traffic, maintenance and lease burden
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Price versus volume, promotions, franchise economics, capitalized pre-opening or one-time costs
owner_cash_valuation_object: Common-owner cash after maintenance, leases, taxes and dilution; normalized service cash multiple
macro_liquidity_route: Employment, real wages, credit, travel and discretionary liquidity
decisive_breaker: Multi-period traffic and collections weaken after normalized labor and occupancy cost

force_or_pressure: Need for normalcy, cleanliness, safety, identity and small control
control_point: Brand trust, shelf availability, assortment and repeat routine
payer_or_funder: Households, retailers, distributors and supplier credit
burden_carrier: Input costs, inventory, trade spend, private label and advertising
operating_denominator: Units, price/mix, repeat purchase, inventory turns, gross-to-net and working capital
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Price/mix masking volume decline, channel stuffing, inventory build, promotional capitalization and acquisition mix
owner_cash_valuation_object: Diluted cash after sustaining brand investment, inventory funding, taxes and buyback/SBC effects; normalized brand cash
macro_liquidity_route: Inflation, real income, household credit and retailer inventory cycles
decisive_breaker: Volume or market share loss, inventory unwind or gross-margin reversal is not explained by mix

control_point: Low-cost reserve, processing asset, logistics or scarce capacity
payer_or_funder: Industrial buyers, builders, farmers and distributors
burden_carrier: Energy, sustaining capex, geology, permitting, transport and environmental obligations
operating_denominator: Realized price net of freight, cost curve, sustaining volume, reserve life and working capital
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Spot-price peak mistaken for durable economics, reserve/cost revisions, capitalized stripping or project costs and working-capital reversal
owner_cash_valuation_object: Through-cycle cash after sustaining capex, reclamation, taxes, debt and dilution; reserve/project NPV
macro_liquidity_route: Manufacturing cycle, construction, food costs, rates, inventory and commodity liquidity
decisive_breaker: Cost-curve migration, reserve deterioration or cash failure after sustaining spend

force_or_pressure: Shelter, care, delivery, connectivity, travel and site scarcity
control_point: Irreplaceable site, zoning, power, tower, lease or logistics node
payer_or_funder: Tenants, guests, operators, partners, debt and equity capital
burden_carrier: Property capex, power, taxes, insurance, vacancy, debt and partners
operating_denominator: Occupancy/lease-up, rent spread, same-property NOI, recurring capex and debt service
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: AFFO/FFO perimeter, straight-line rent, development capitalization, JV/VIE and partner claims and dilution
owner_cash_valuation_object: Property/project cash after recurring capex, debt, partner/preferred claims and taxes; project NPV/IRR
macro_liquidity_route: Rates, credit spreads, refinancing, construction finance and power availability
decisive_breaker: Lease-up delay, rent loss, capex escalation or funding dilution overwhelms project return

force_or_pressure: Digital dependence, identity, security, compute, storage and workflow complexity
control_point: Permissioning, network enforcement, process control and installed software/hardware
payer_or_funder: Enterprises, governments, developers and network/semiconductor customers
burden_carrier: R&D, support, compute/power, channel, cybersecurity, SBC and obsolescence
operating_denominator: Retention, utilization, service attach, backlog conversion, gross margin, R&D and capex intensity
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: ARR/RPO/bookings versus recognized cash, deferred revenue, factoring, capitalization, SBC, acquisition and restructuring normalization
owner_cash_valuation_object: Diluted owner cash after R&D, true maintenance capex, SBC, working capital and debt; cycle-normalized FCF/earnings
macro_liquidity_route: Enterprise budgets, semiconductor capex, rates, AI infrastructure financing and risk appetite
decisive_breaker: Retention/utilization decay, factoring unwind or reinvestment/SBC consumes distributable cash

force_or_pressure: Aging, chronic disease, access friction, staffing and reimbursement constraint
control_point: Device, site, lab, distributor, drug route or care-coordination workflow
payer_or_funder: Patients, payers, government programs, providers and manufacturers
burden_carrier: Clinicians/caregivers, inventory, receivables, regulation, litigation, capital and labor
operating_denominator: Procedures/visits, utilization, reimbursement, payer mix, staffing, inventory and collections
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Acquired revenue versus acquired return, adjusted charges, lease/securitization perimeter, payer timing, legal and restructuring cash
owner_cash_valuation_object: Common-owner cash after labor, working capital, maintenance capex, legal cash, leases, taxes and dilution; cohort/provider return
macro_liquidity_route: Employment and wages, public reimbursement, medical inflation, credit and demographic demand
current_grade: article-ready / entity and cohort cash open
decisive_breaker: Reimbursement compression, labor failure, cohort losses or receivable deterioration

force_or_pressure: Energy cost flowing into transport, food, rent, goods and industry
control_point: Production, decline management, refining, storage, pipeline/LNG route or service capacity
payer_or_funder: Households, utilities, industrial users, exporters, counterparties and lenders
burden_carrier: Commodity volatility, depletion, sustaining capex, turnaround, inventory, debt and environmental obligations
operating_denominator: Realized price, throughput, crack/spread, decline rate, utilization, maintenance capex and working capital
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Hedging/perimeter, inventory timing, peak margin, reserve depletion, capitalized costs, non-GAAP cash and acquisition mix
owner_cash_valuation_object: Cash after maintenance capex, hedges, taxes, debt, abandonment and dilution; through-cycle asset/project return
macro_liquidity_route: Inflation, rates, dollar/liquidity, commodity inventories, trade and capex cycle
decisive_breaker: Decline/turnaround cost, spread normalization or maintenance spend erases cash

force_or_pressure: Household/business need for liquidity, payment, savings, insurance and risk transfer
control_point: Deposit franchise, payment rail, underwriting, distribution or capital allocation
payer_or_funder: Depositors, card users, borrowers, policyholders and institutional funders
burden_carrier: Credit losses, funding cost, capital requirements, fraud, duration, regulation and policyholders
operating_denominator: Net interest income after losses/funding, fee retention, delinquencies, deposits, capital and reserve adequacy
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Reserve releases, charge-off timing, receivable securitization, fair value, capitalization, deposit mix and one-time gains
owner_cash_valuation_object: Unrestricted common earnings/cash after losses, capital, funding, claims and dilution; normalized ROE/FCFE
macro_liquidity_route: Central-bank liquidity, yield curve, unemployment, household leverage and credit spreads
decisive_breaker: Worsening vintages, deposit runoff, funding-cost pressure or capital need exceeds distributions

force_or_pressure: Inflation and household trade-down without abandoning all routines
control_point: Assortment, price architecture, inventory discovery and channel access
payer_or_funder: Households, vendors, consumer credit, advertisers and members
burden_carrier: Inventory, markdowns, labor, leases, supplier finance, services and taxes
operating_denominator: Comparable sales, units/transactions, inventory turns, gross margin, OCF-to-capex and dilution
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Support reversal, supplier-finance normalization, attached-service perimeter, lease/tax burden and adjusted EPS
owner_cash_valuation_object: Common-owner cash after normalized working capital, maintenance capex, leases, taxes, support and dilution; expectation-based equity value
macro_liquidity_route: Real wages, CPI, consumer credit, employment, retailer inventory and rates
decisive_breaker: Normalized demand and cash fail across common periods

theme: Scarce physical assets and contractual control
force_or_pressure: Long-lived production, permitting and reserve scarcity
control_point: Contractual entitlement to a named output or receipt
payer_or_funder: Operator, stream/royalty buyer, industrial purchaser and lender
burden_carrier: Operator labor/capex/permitting; buyer funding, taxes and counterparty settlement
operating_denominator: Payable/attributable output, sold volume, price, reserve-backed delivery and funding cost
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Production versus sales, reserve proxy versus payable curve, acquisition funding, debt allocation, receipt and tax perimeter
owner_cash_valuation_object: Contract-level cash after funding, taxes, debt and dilution; asset NPV/IRR
macro_liquidity_route: Metals cycle, real rates, dollar, mine capex and counterparty liquidity
decisive_breaker: Named credit issuance, sale/receivable, bank receipt or reserve-backed delivery fails

force_or_pressure: Savings, premiums, credit and investment demand moving through legal wrappers
control_point: Origination, asset selection, insurance spread, borrower/facility and entity transfer
payer_or_funder: Policyholders, depositors, institutional investors, borrowers and parent capital
burden_carrier: Regulated entities, borrowers, reinsurers, funding providers, NCI/preferred holders and common owners
operating_denominator: Spread after liability/funding cost, credit losses, statutory capital, fees, remittance and dilution
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Fair value versus funded principal, wrapper versus lender role, statutory income versus cash, related-party elimination, reserve and acquisition accounting
owner_cash_valuation_object: Named-asset or facility cash after liability cost, capital, claims, fees and entity allocation; liability-adjusted return
macro_liquidity_route: Rates, liquidity, credit spreads, collateral values, fiscal/money creation and refinancing
current_grade: qualified pilot / receipt and residual open
decisive_breaker: Borrower collections, liability-adjusted spread or unrestricted parent residual fails

force_or_pressure: Reliability, electrification and large-load demand under public oversight
control_point: Rate base, tariff/recovery category, interconnection, named project or customer obligation
payer_or_funder: Ratepayers, approved customer recovery, contracts, debt, equity and NCI
burden_carrier: Construction, fuel, regulatory timing, financing, storm risk and customers
operating_denominator: Billed/collected revenue, paid capex, CWIP, in-service assets, recovery balance and capital allocation
qoe_financial_shenanigans_control: Approved recovery versus receipts, AFUDC/CWIP, category attribution, customer deposits, project approval and shared ownership
owner_cash_valuation_object: Common-owner cash after paid maintenance/growth capex, financing, taxes, regulatory timing and dilution; project return
macro_liquidity_route: Rates, inflation, load growth, fiscal policy, power prices, transmission and financing liquidity
decisive_breaker: Billed-to-collected weakness or project return fails after funding and customer burden
